unit.why: A single tale about Rabbi Zvi Hirsh (of Zhidachov) who, while gravely ill at the Seer of Lublin's court on Sukkot, is visited in the sukkah by an unknown old man later revealed as Abraham our father.

stories.start_quote: סיפר מורינו הגה״ק מוהרי״א מקומארנא זצ"ל שבפ"א
stories.end_quote: הוא הי' אברהם אבינו ע"ה והדבר ידוע
stories.summary_en: When R. Zvi was very ill at the Seer of Lublin's court on Sukkot, he had himself carried up to the Seer's small sukkah to eat an olive's bulk; there his attendant found an unknown old man sitting with him, who vanished, and R. Zvi later revealed that it was Abraham our father (one of the ushpizin).
